description.value: Relish is a full-service pub in the heart of downtown Vancouver, situated between Hornby and Howe Streets on Nelson. The venue features an outdoor patio equipped with heaters, a sound system, and multiple TVs for sports viewing, making it a lively stop in a dense urban cycling corridor. Regular programming includes NFL game nights and weekly wing specials.
